P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait on this page; it features a large typographic headline instead.

P05.rationale: The two case studies feature clearly framed portraits of the clients at meaningful size within their respective columns.

P07.rationale: A robust social-proof apparatus is present in the form of a dedicated section with client testimonials and a row of reference logos.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present as large headlines ('Statuslücke', 'Die Ego-Logik') that act as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations bound to numbers are clearly visible in the top section (e.g., '100+', '30-50%').

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and imagery.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present via the dark green sidebar and the subtle gradient on the right column.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo in the top right corner is treated with a dark overlay (scrim) to ensure overlaid text remains readable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown on this page; it relies entirely on typography and photography.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to real businesses (logos are visible) rather than generic stock photos.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is dense and content-heavy throughout.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim; it is placed in clear white or dark zones for readability.
